sentences.text: On 1.27, VolumeAttributesClass is not mentioned, so no information is provided in that release’s excerpts.
On 1.31, a VolumeAttributesClass is used when a PersistentVolume (PV) belonging to the class needs to be dynamically provisioned or modified.

citations.quote: Each VolumeAttributesClass contains the `driverName` and `parameters`, which are used when a PersistentVolume (PV) belonging to the class needs to be dynamically provisioned or modified.
